title: HESTA bolsters property and investment risk leadership
full_text:
HESTA has appointed Briar Dowsett as general manager, property, and Daniel Tait as general manager, investment and financial risk, strengthening two key areas as the fund continues to grow.
Dowsett will join HESTA in November to lead its property team in the newly created role, reporting to deputy chief investment officer and head of portfolio management Jeff Brunton.
Bringing more than 30 years of experience across superannuation, institutional funds management and real estate, Dowsett joins the fund after almost a decade in senior leadership at QIC Real Estate.
Her career has included strengthening investment governance and developing property programs designed to balance returns, risk and long-term value creation across diversified real estate portfolios.
“Property plays an important role in helping us deliver strong, long-term returns for our more than one million members. Briar’s appointment to this new role will strengthen our ability to keep identifying quality opportunities, in Australia and offshore, as we continue to grow and diversify this asset class,” Brunton said.
Commenting on her appointment, Dowsett said she was looking forward to helping manage HESTA’s property portfolio for the benefit of members.
“HESTA has a long and proud record of investing with purpose. I’m looking forward to contributing to a property portfolio that performs for members over the long term while making a positive contribution to the communities they live and work in,” Dowsett said.
Tait will begin his role in late October, taking responsibility for the fund’s investment and financial risk management capability.
Reporting to head of risk James Haviland, Tait brings more than two decades of experience across financial markets, capital risk, regulatory risk and compliance.
HESTA chief risk officer Natalie Alford said Tait’s experience would support the fund’s risk capabilities as its operations expanded.
“Daniel’s deep superannuation and investment risk expertise, combined with his strong track record of partnering with the business, will help ensure our investment and financial risk capability keeps pace as the Fund continues to grow for its members,” Alford said.
Tait joins HESTA from Aware Super and has previously held senior risk positions at National Australia Bank and AustralianSuper.
“I’m delighted to join HESTA as the Fund enters this next stage of growth, using my skills and experience in investment risk to help the Fund protect and grow members’ long-term super balances,” he said.
